sample_reviews.author: James T.
sample_reviews.text: Murray Plumbing sorted our boiler out the same day we called. Absolutely brilliant service, friendly and very professional. Would highly recommend to anyone in the Wirral area.

sample_reviews.author: Sarah M.
sample_reviews.text: Had a leak under the kitchen sink that was getting worse by the hour. Called and got a same-day visit. Fixed quickly and at a very fair price. Couldn't be happier.

sample_reviews.author: David R.
sample_reviews.text: Great local plumber. Fitted a new bathroom for us and the finish was spot on. Turned up on time every day and kept everything tidy. Will definitely use again.

brand.usp: Murray Plumbing & Heating delivers fast, reliable plumbing and heating solutions across Birkenhead and the wider Wirral, with a no-fuss approach and honest pricing every time.
brand.hero_headline: Your Local Plumber in Birkenhead & Wirral
brand.about_paragraph: I'm the team behind Murray Plumbing & Heating, based right here in Birkenhead and proudly serving homeowners across the Wirral and Liverpool. Whether it's a dripping tap, a new boiler, or a full bathroom refit, we bring years of hands-on experience and a commitment to doing the job right first time. We treat every home like our own — clean, professional work at prices you'll be happy with.
